austin.summary: Austin, picking 5th in the snake, you built a quiet machine. Rank 2 of 5 with 19 counted points, and the leader has 20 — that's breathing distance. Three of your four are still in the game, your draft GPA is 2.75, and Eric at pick #16 ranking 1 is highway robbery. Ep 3 gave you +8, Ep 4 only +3. With 73 points still on the table, this thing is wide open.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Linnea, Carter, and Eric are all sitting at 5 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — a three-headed engine, with Eric's A grade at pick #16 the best value on your board.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 was the reach — 4 pts, rank 17 of 21, an F grade, and the 4th voted out in Ep 4, the same week that gave you your worst take at +3.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You've got feet in three tribes — Dina, Dina, and Toka — so watch whether Linnea and Eric keep that Dina pair humming while Carter holds his own across camp.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you lost Aaliyah in Episode 1 — First Blood, the badge nobody wants — and you've been climbing out of that hole ever since. Here's the truth: Cristian, Alexis and Kilby are each sitting at 5 pts, rank 1 of 21, and that's a draft GPA of 3 doing real work. You're rank 5 of 5 with 15 counted points, the leader has 20, and 73 points are still on the table. Nobody's buried.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is the steal of your draft — 5 pts, rank 1 of 21, grade A, and he's got company in Cristian and Alexis sitting on the exact same line.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung — first voted out in Episode 1, 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, grade F.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You went +3 in Ep 1 and +6 in Ep 3, so the question is whether 3 of 4 still in the game can keep stacking weeks like that one.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick in the snake and you built a roster with brains to spare — a sociology professor, a federal prosecutor, a baseball executive, a gate agent and an OB/GYN resident. You sit rank 3 of 5 with 18 counted points, raw 20, with Rob dropped under the best-4 rule, and 3 of 5 still breathing. Ep 3 gave you +7, Ep 4 only +3. Leader has 20. You're right there.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Jelly, Mike and Sharonda are all sitting at 5 pts and rank 1 of 21 — three co-leaders hauling your torch, with your Idol Whisperer badge logging 2 found across the roster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 was the reach, going out 3rd in Ep 3 with 3 pts and a rank of 18 of 21, while Rob's quit left 2 pts dropped — and that's how you earned Torch Collector with 2 torches snuffed.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Sharonda, your leftover at pick #21 and the steal of the draft, keeps earning that Leftover Luck badge — and with 73 points still on the table, she's the storyline to follow.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted 2nd and built a team with muscle, mischief, and a microphone. Three of your four are still in the game, and Kristin, Ori, and Brady are each sitting on 5 pts, rank 1 of 21. You're rank 4 of 5 with 16 counted points, the leader has 20, and there are 73 points still on the table. Draft GPA of 2.5, best week Ep 3 (+6), worst Ep 2 (+3). You're very much in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Brady Booker — your pick #19 steal, the pro wrestler who values trust above all — sits at 5 pts, rank 1 of 21, right alongside Kristin and Ori.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani was your reach at pick #12 and her game ended on Day 5 in 20th place, leaving you with 1 pts and an F on that slot.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether your Toka pair in Kristin and Brady can keep pace with Ori over on Savu and push those 16 counted points toward the leader's 20.

tim.summary: Tim, drafting fourth and leading wire-to-wire? That's a statement. Twenty counted points, rank 1 of 5, and all 4 of 4 castaways still standing while five torches have already been snuffed — you own the Untouchable badge outright. Five boots, none of them yours. A 3.75 draft GPA, with Thien An at pick #17 as your steal. Ep 3 gave you +8, your worst week was Ep 1 at +4. There are 94 points still on the table.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Lewis, Maggie, Devin, and Thien An are all sitting on 5 pts and all four rank 1 of 21, which is why you're the leader at 20.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Lewis Kelly is the only B on an otherwise straight-A roster, and the cheeky, devilish farmer in the school bus plays a style that cuts both ways.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: With 94 points still on the table and the leader at 20, watch whether Thien An — the youngest castaway out there at 24 — keeps justifying that #17 price tag.
